prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1273; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of motion. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the knee findings observed on examination. Imaging and physical examination clearly confirm the injury, and the findings are consistent with the reported mechanism. The patient has a remote history of a minor strain involving the same region, which resolved completely without residual limitation and did not affect the current presentation. Over a course of 23 visits, care progressed through a conventional sequence of therapeutic exercise, manual therapy, and activity modification. Symptoms, strength, and mobility improved steadily, and the frequency of visits tapered as the patient recovered. Billing records reflect single, appropriately spaced charges for each service rendered, with no repeated billing. The patient is currently near maximum medical improvement, with residual stiffness expected to continue to resolve with a home exercise program.
